component_theorem: Give Z,ss charge0 and original variables their nonnegative x charges. Every Jacobian row has charge>=1, while lambda and g=Zlambda-ss^(W+1) have charge0. Thus H_(0,B)=(g)_(0,B) for every B. Projection of homogeneous sums proves both inclusions. No quotient by positive-charge variables is formed.
independent_buchberger_closure: A single nonzero polynomial g is a complete Groebner basis of (g): LM(a*g)=LM(a)*LM(g), and there are no distinct S-pairs. With the declared one wp block and ss last, equal-weight reverse lex compares ss-exponent0 in Zlambda against W+1 in ss^(W+1), hence LM(g)=Z*LM(lambda). It cannot divide the pure ss power ss^B, so its normal form is ss^B for every B.
allowed_claim: Exact nonmembership in target component (0,B), even when a separate all-row std run at B timed out. Record target-component completion separately; do not mark the all-row truncated basis complete.
saturation_boundary: This does not quotient by overflow monomials, does not introduce nilpotence, and does not invert a variable in a finite quotient. The charge argument fails after Tc-ss^(n+m), which is not homogeneous in the same x charge. It also does not ignore charge-zero characteristic equations U.
